## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (ruff format, ruff check, all tests)
- [ ] Tests for new behavior, with expected values from PARI (cypari2) or SymPy, hard-coded
- [ ] New types or public functions have LaTeX support and a golden LaTeX test
- [ ] Works in the `er2` command, Jupyter and Quarto
- [ ] A line in CHANGELOG.md under **Unreleased** (user-visible changes)

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
